extracted.name: Rachel's Tomato Basil Soup
extracted.description: Fresh basil is the key to Rachel's creamy tomato basil soup recipe made with canned tomatoes, chicken broth, tomato-vegetable juice, and heavy cream.
ingredient_lines: 20 fresh basil leaves, cut into thin strips
instruction_lines: Combine tomatoes, chicken broth, and vegetable juice in a large saucepan; bring to a boil and cook for 30 minutes. Off heat, stir in basil. Purée soup with an immersion blender until smooth, if desired.
Stir in cream and butter over medium-low heat until butter is melted.
